intro: Zambia has about 21 million people from over 70 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: Bemba, Tonga, Lozi and Nyanja speakers are among the largest groups. English is official. Zambia calls itself a Christian nation in its constitution.

chapters.title: Lusaka
text: Lusaka, the capital, is one of Africa's fastest-growing cities.

keyTerms.meaning: A large ethnic group and language.
